modes.live: launch native Koronos ring-3 interactive built-in console
modes.install: launch installer preflight report; disk mutation unavailable
modes.safe_graphics: boot safe text/serial profile; native graphics backend unavailable
modes.diagnostics: run boot and syscall diagnostics target
modes.recovery: run diagnostics-only recovery target; repair operations unavailable
modes.network: maintenance target; native Koronos network service not yet available

policy: Menu and launcher selection is shared across Jasper, Gates, Spit Fire and GRUB2. The selected target must declare its actual runtime capability; unavailable capabilities fail closed.
